external_prerequisites.title: board: title deeds that belong to one room

tasks.title: Promote the staged trade_offers migration
tasks.dod: The staged pair matches data-model.md (including note), is promoted as migrations/NNNN_trades_offers.sql, and the up/down/up rehearsal and pnpm check are green.

tasks.title: Promote the staged trade_offer_properties migration
tasks.dod: The staged pair is promoted as migrations/NNNN_trades_offer_properties.sql, the up/down/up rehearsal passes, and pnpm check is green.

tasks.title: Add the transaction helper to src/shared/db.ts
tasks.dod: A test on an in-memory database shows the helper commits on return, rolls back and rethrows on a throw, and joins a transaction that is already open.

tasks.title: Hand a clock to buildApp and makeTestApp
tasks.dod: buildApp takes a clock (system clock by default), makeTestApp lets a test pass one, and pnpm check is green with the existing tests unchanged.

tasks.title: Model the trade offer in src/trades/domain/offer.ts
tasks.dod: offer.ts exports the offer type, the derived state, the validation, the repository interface and the three ports, and pnpm typecheck and pnpm arch:check are green.

tasks.title: Add the offer repository on node:sqlite
tasks.dod: offerRepo.ts implements the repository interface of T5 with one statement per read of data-model.md § Indexes, and pnpm typecheck and pnpm arch:check are green.

tasks.title: Wire the trades module and resolve the acting player
tasks.dod: A request to a trades route with no player secret or an unknown one gets 401 unauthorized in an HTTP test, and pnpm check is green with trades as the fifth context.

tasks.title: Propose a trade offer: happy path and request-only refusals
tasks.dod: POST /trade-offers returns 201 with a pending offer for AC-01 and 400 invalid for refusals 2–7 of the contract (AC-02, AC-03, AC-05, AC-06b), each in an HTTP test.

tasks.title: Propose a trade offer: refusals that depend on state
tasks.dod: POST /trade-offers returns 409 conflict for refusals 8–10 of the contract (AC-04, AC-05, AC-06), each in an HTTP test that also shows no offer was recorded.

tasks.title: List incoming and outgoing trade offers
tasks.dod: GET /trade-offers/incoming shows only pending offers addressed to the acting player (AC-13), GET /trade-offers/outgoing shows every offer they made with its state, expired included (AC-11, AC-15), and neither shows an offer of another pair (AC-14), each in an HTTP test.

tasks.title: Reject a trade offer
tasks.dod: POST /trade-offers/{id}/reject returns 200 with a rejected offer for AC-10 and for a recipient who left the room (AC-18), lets the same offer be made again at once for AC-10b, and returns the 400 of the contract for a malformed id and the 404 or 409 for AC-08, AC-09, AC-12 and AC-14, each in an HTTP test.

tasks.title: Accept a trade offer: the exchange in one transaction
tasks.dod: POST /trade-offers/{id}/accept moves every title deed and all money for AC-07; for AC-16, AC-17 and AC-18 (either side left the room) returns 409 with owners, balances and the pending state unchanged; gives the answer refusals of a malformed id, AC-08, AC-09, AC-12 and AC-14; and awaits nothing inside the transaction, each in an HTTP test.

tasks.title: Test the quality goals: atomicity, concurrency, expiry edge, latency
tasks.dod: The QG-1 to QG-4 scenarios of sad §10 pass as automated tests: fails-midway invariants, 100 of 100 single winners, the answer refused at expires_at, p95 within the PRD §6 targets in a separate latency run.

tasks.title: Reconcile the contract report and the docs with the built feature
tasks.dod: /sdlc:api-forge trade-offers --reconcile ends at PASS or PASS (with deferrals) with the unauthorized deferral closed, the contract rows of the test plan pass, and pnpm contract:types followed by pnpm check is green.
